definitions.gloss: childcare, nursery care, early childhood education
definitions.explanation: The care and education of young children, especially in a professional or institutional setting such as a daycare center or nursery school.

examples.japanese: {保育|ほいく}{園|えん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
{保育|ほいく}{士|し}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}りたい→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I want to get a childcare worker qualification.

examples.japanese: ⟦{待機|たいき}{児童|じどう}→待機児童：08624_taikijidou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{保育|ほいく}⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{拡充|かくじゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{急|いそ}がれている→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧。
examples.english: Due to the waitlisted children problem, expansion of childcare services is urgently needed.

notes:
GRAMMAR: Functions as a noun and as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb ({保育|ほいく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {保育|ほいく}{園|えん} (nursery school, daycare center)
- {保育|ほいく}{士|し} (childcare worker, nursery teacher)
- {保育|ほいく}{所|しょ} / {保育|ほいく}{所|じょ} (daycare facility)
- {保育|ほいく}{料|りょう} (childcare fees)
- {無償|むしょう}{保育|ほいく} (free childcare)

SOCIAL CONTEXT: {保育|ほいく} is a major social topic in Japan. ⟦{待機|たいき}{児童|じどう}→待機児童：08624_taikijidou⟧ (children on daycare waiting lists) has been a persistent issue, especially in urban areas. The phrase {保育|ほいく}{園|えん}⟦{落|お}ちた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧ ("rejected from daycare") became a social media sensation in 2016.
